description: This file defines classes and functions for managing hardware mappings and device discovery in a Zephyr-based testing environment. It includes classes for DUT (Device Under Test) and HardwareMap, with methods for loading, saving, and scanning connected hardware devices, as well as handling YAML configurations and device detection.

classes.name: DUT
classes.description: Represents a device under test with properties like serial number, platform, product, and connection status. Includes methods for converting to dictionary and string representation.

classes.name: HardwareMap
classes.description: Manages a collection of DUTs, including device discovery, loading/saving hardware configurations, and summarizing connected devices.

methods.name: DUT.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a DUT instance with optional parameters such as id, serial, platform, product, and connection settings.

methods.name: DUT.to_dict
methods.description: Converts the DUT instance to a dictionary excluding internal attributes.

methods.name: DUT.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DUT instance.

methods.name: HardwareMap.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a HardwareMap instance with environment options.

methods.name: HardwareMap.discover
methods.description: Discovers connected hardware devices or loads from existing hardware map based on options.

methods.name: HardwareMap.summary
methods.description: Prints a summary table of connected devices filtered by selected platforms.

methods.name: HardwareMap.add_device
methods.description: Adds a new DUT to the hardware map with specified serial, platform, and connection type.

methods.name: HardwareMap.load
methods.description: Loads hardware configuration from a YAML file and creates DUT instances accordingly.

methods.name: HardwareMap.save
methods.description: Saves current DUTs to a YAML hardware map file, updating existing entries or creating new ones.

methods.name: HardwareMap.dump
methods.description: Prints a table of DUTs, optionally filtered by connection status or platform.
